anomaly_alerts.title: How these numbers are counted
anomaly_alerts.description: Read as SaaS subscription data (MRR, ARR, paying customers, new MRR, churned MRR, logo churn, net revenue retention, gross revenue retention). MRR is the monthly run-rate of the customers paying at the latest date (an annual plan ÷ 12, net of discounts; trials, paused and unpaid subscriptions out, past due in), not revenue; movements and retention compare each customer's MRR at month-ends over the 12 months to that date, and annual churn is measured on the customers paying 12 months earlier, never a monthly rate × 12. A customer who starts and leaves inside one month appears in no month-end figure. The churned column is a flag, not a dated event: the share of rows flagged is not a churn rate.

Contraction MRR of $13,587.47 over the 12-month window is the primary drag on revenue retention, as no customers churned outright across the 200 accounts in force at 31 Oct 2026.
